entries.mem0ai/mem0: This universal memory layer provides multi-level storage for user, session, and agent states using temporal reasoning and multi-signal retrieval. It is an official Hermes Agent provider available as a managed cloud service or an Apache-2.0 self-hosted SDK.
entries.volcengine/OpenViking: OpenViking organizes agent context as a virtual filesystem using viking:// URIs and a three-tier loading system to achieve significant token reduction. This official provider archives sessions as editable Markdown files and demonstrated a 43-49% task-completion gain in LoCoMo10 benchmarks.
entries.topoteretes/cognee: Cognee implements a self-hosted knowledge graph engine that distills session lessons into durable, searchable permanent memory. It supports local extraction and embedding models, allowing agents to maintain long-term memory across sessions without requiring external LLM API keys.
entries.supermemoryai/supermemory: This official Hermes provider features a custom vector graph engine capable of sub-300ms recall at scales exceeding 100B tokens per month. It maintains auto-updated user profiles and supports multi-modal extraction from sources including PDFs, images, and code.
entries.garrytan/gbrain: GBrain provides synthesized answers with citations and gap analysis by creating a knowledge graph with typed edges without LLM calls. It is designed for multi-user company environments, offering scoped data access for secure organizational memory.
entries.vectorize-io/hindsight: Hindsight facilitates long-term retain, recall, and reflect workflows through an LLM wrapper that enables disposition-aware response generation. It supports multiple programming languages and deployment options ranging from bare-metal to Kubernetes.
entries.plastic-labs/honcho: Honcho is a FastAPI-based memory library that serves as the upstream foundation for the Hermes self-hosted wrapper. It enables the creation of stateful agents through managed or local deployments using Python and TypeScript SDKs.
entries.campfirein/byterover-cli: This official provider treats memory as a git repository, utilizing a five-tier retrieval system where four tiers are non-LLM for sub-100ms performance. It features an interactive TUI and employs version control operations like branching and merging to manage a plain markdown context tree.
entries.mnemosyne-oss/mnemosyne: Mnemosyne is a zero-dependency memory system that uses a single SQLite database to achieve sub-millisecond performance. It integrates via MCP or Python SDK and utilizes episodic compression to ensure sub-linear storage growth.
entries.ClaudioDrews/memory-os: This seven-layer memory system utilizes a local infrastructure of Qdrant, Redis, and SQLite to manage structured facts and vector search. It employs a Ground Truth hierarchy to ensure agents prioritize specific injected context and auto-curated wikis.
entries.greyhaven-ai/autocontext: AutoContext is a recursive self-improving harness that generates filesystem-first artifacts such as traces and context bundles. It uses outcome-gated promotion to update context based on verified trials, supporting integration via CLI, MCP, and Pi extensions.
entries.stephenschoettler/hermes-lcm: This Lossless Context Management plugin uses a hierarchical DAG and SQLite store to ensure no messages are lost during agent operations. It provides specialized recall tools like lcm_grep to recover specific details from the persistent message history.
entries.vshulcz/deja-vu: This tool indexes existing local session history from various coding agents without requiring a model or capture step. It provides an MCP recall tool for cross-agent retrieval while stripping keys and tokens for safer model transmission.
entries.elkimek/honcho-self-hosted: This self-hosted backend enables private cross-session memory for Hermes Agent using Docker, PostgreSQL, and Redis. It supports local inference servers or any OpenAI-compatible LLM provider for persistent state management.
entries.plur-ai/plur: Plur stores memory as plain-text YAML engrams on local disk to facilitate portability across multi-agent systems. It utilizes hybrid retrieval combining BM25 and local embeddings, accessible via an MCP server integration.
entries.Signet-AI/signetai: Signet-AI provides a local-first identity and memory layer that syncs state across Hermes Agent, Claude Code, and other harnesses. It supports real-time ingestion from Obsidian, Discord, and GitHub, achieving 97.6% accuracy in LongMemEval benchmarks.
entries.yoloshii/ClawMem: This on-device context engine operates locally without cloud dependencies or API keys. It employs hybrid retrieval through BM25 and vector search, integrating with agents via MCP and specialized plugins.
entries.Sibyl-Labs/Sibyl-Memory: Sibyl-Memory uses a five-tier hierarchical SQLite schema with FTS5 search instead of vector databases or embeddings. The five-package family includes an SDK, CLI, and a dedicated Hermes adapter for durable file-based storage.
entries.EfficientContext/ContextPilot: This optimization tool reduces prefill latency by 1.5–3x and saves up to 36% of tokens through block reordering and deduplication. It provides native plugin support for the Hermes Agent ecosystem to accelerate long-context inference.
entries.yantrikos/yantrikdb-hermes-plugin: This plugin features explainable retrieval by tagging every recalled memory with a 'why_retrieved' label. It includes primitives for contradiction tracking and a self-directing loop to identify and queue knowledge gaps.
entries.JanYork/llm-wiki-cli: This CLI maintains agent-driven wikis with citations and provenance stored in SQLite with rebuildable Markdown projections. It allows agents to autonomously evolve persistent knowledge across sessions using portable archives.
entries.ccf/agentcairn: Agentcairn uses an Obsidian vault as the source of truth, storing durable memory as inspectable Markdown files with frontmatter. It utilizes a local DuckDB cache for hybrid search and integrates with coding agents via MCP servers.
entries.amanning3390/flowstate-qmd: This anticipatory memory system prefetches context by watching agent session logs in real-time. It relies on local-first storage using SQLite-vec and GGUF models, delivered through an MCP-native server.
entries.yepyhun/Brainstack: Brainstack integrates Hindsight, Graphiti, and MemPalace into a single memory kernel for Hermes Agent. It manages state using SQLite, Kuzu, and Chroma to provide agents with purpose-built evidence packets for each query.
entries.Perseus-Computing-LLC/perseus: This memory layer resolves live workspace states into verified facts to ensure agents only load necessary context. It provides local-first session history tracking and supports MCP-native integration via stdio or SSE servers.
entries.generalbusiness-ai/keep: This reflective memory system utilizes semantic search with BM25 full-text and ranked graph traversal. It features automated indexing for multimedia and codebases, using edge tags to create navigable, bidirectional relationships between notes.
entries.alias8818/hermes-tool-slimmer: Designed to reduce prompt token overhead, this tool uses local BM25 ranking to select relevant tool schemas. It includes a dashboard for tracking estimated savings and is compatible with Hermes Agent v0.14.0 native tool search.
entries.conorbronsdon/claude-context-os: This Git-backed workflow layer manages context for coding agents using hash-checked proposals and receipts for reviewed updates. It offers a source-neutral migration workflow for exporting chats and documents across supported agents.
entries.Ladybug-Memory/hermes-memory-plugin: This local-only plugin uses a single .lbdb embedded graph database to store memories with a 1-10 importance ranking. It prioritizes high-value information during context prefetch using BM25 keyword search and named graph relationships.
entries.MukundaKatta/hermes-agentmemory: This episodic memory plugin features a pull-model that supports immediate event deletion and an on-demand summarizer. It provides a trace.jsonl audit log to track every prefetch and memory operation for transparency.
entries.piprail/piprail: This SDK and MCP server enables agents to manage budget-bound wallets and process x402 payments across multiple blockchain families. The system operates without a backend, database, or API keys, allowing agents to pay for API usage directly.
entries.stepanov1975/hermes-local-knowledge: This plugin indexes local skills, scripts, and MCP configurations to facilitate knowledge search and neighbor traversal. It supports automatic tool-OKF generation through detached model calls to streamline local capability routing.
entries.yonro/hermes-xmemo-plugin: Providing cross-session continuity, this provider allows agents to read memories from other connected agents. It utilizes native lifecycle hooks for session snapshots and a local SQLite layer for reliable caching and write outbox management.
entries.futurebrowser/hermes-exabase-plugin: This plugin integrates Exabase M-1 for self-organizing long-term memory storage and retrieval. It includes tools for manual memory storage and supports configurable query expansion and result reranking.
entries.sourcevault-ai/sourcevault-code-tools: This plugin provides private local code memory for repositories through deterministic slash commands and LLM-callable tools. It requires a local SourceVault server to handle indexing, vector storage, and grounded Q&A.
entries.visorcraft/MongrelDB-Hermes: This AI-native memory solution features AES-256-GCM encryption at rest and multiple retrieval methods including HNSW ANN and FM-index. It supports both native Rust FFI and HTTP daemon modes with built-in MinHash deduplication.
entries.penfieldlabs/hermes-penfield: This provider offers 17 tools for memory management and knowledge graph traversal using a hybrid search approach that combines BM25, vector, and graph methods. It supports automatic context checkpointing during message compression to maintain continuity.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-memory-kit: This tool focuses on memory hygiene through a git-backed directory of versioned markdown files rather than a traditional database. It utilizes 'rot' and 'lint' curators to identify stale or conflicting data, proposing evidence-cited diffs for manual review via five slash commands.

entries.obra/superpowers: This framework automates specification elicitation and implementation planning while adhering to TDD, YAGNI, and DRY principles. It functions as a software development methodology that integrates with multiple coding harnesses and CLI tools.
entries.nexu-io/open-design: A local-first system that enables Hermes Agent to generate web, mobile, and motion graphic artifacts through a CLI. It supports native agent runtimes via the DeepSeek Harness and exports designs to formats including HTML, PDF, PPTX, and MP4.
entries.mukul975/Anthropic-Cybersecurity-Skills: This library provides 818 structured security skills mapped to frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK, NIST CSF 2.0, and ATLAS. It is compatible with over 26 AI platforms, offering coverage across 34 distinct security domains.
entries.Agents365-ai/drawio-skill: This skill converts codebases, infrastructure-as-code, and schemas into draw.io diagrams using natural language descriptions. It includes a CLI and MCP server that support incremental synchronization while preserving manual layout changes.
entries.internet-court/internet-court-skill: Serving as a trust layer for agent-to-agent commerce, this tool provides a master router for natural-language mandates and ERC-7710 delegated permissions. it incorporates x402 payments, escrow, and a dedicated dispute resolution layer for secure transactions.
entries.conorbronsdon/avoid-ai-writing: This tool audits and rewrites content to eliminate detectable AI writing patterns for agents like Hermes and Claude Code. It offers three distinct operational modes: detect-only, edit-in-place, and full rewrite.
entries.AMAP-ML/SkillClaw: This agentic evolver automates skill deduplication and cross-pollination across isolated agent silos for Hermes and OpenAI-compatible APIs. It features a bilingual dashboard for inspecting session traces and monitoring collective skill evolution.
entries.wondelai/skills: A cross-platform library featuring 51 expert frameworks and 14 guided metaskills compatible with agent-plugins.org specifications. It maintains session state directly within a project's documentation folder to support Claude Code and other agents.
entries.mohitagw15856/pm-claude-skills: This collection contains 1,162 professional skills for tasks ranging from PRD creation to lease decoding. The skills run natively in Hermes Agent and are provided as markdown files for easy export to other assistants.
entries.ZeroPointRepo/youtube-skills: This plugin enables Hermes Agent to perform video searches, browse channels, and extract transcripts or playlist data. It requires a TranscriptAPI key and is compatible with multiple environments including OpenClaw and Windsurf.
entries.Romanescu11/hermes-skill-factory: A meta-skill plugin that monitors active workflows to automatically detect and propose reusable skill patterns. It generates both SKILL.md documentation and Python plugin scaffolds, managed through integrated slash commands.
entries.Cranot/super-hermes: These skills enable Hermes Agent to generate its own custom thinking instructions and analytical prompts for specific tasks. The system utilizes pre-built analytical lenses and provides reports that highlight potential analysis blind spots.
entries.DougTrajano/pydantic-ai-skills: This project provides type-safe agentskills.io support for Pydantic AI, featuring remote skill registries via S3 and Git. It is essential for secure extensibility through sandboxed execution of untrusted scripts and bundled resource management.
entries.tlehman/litprog-skill: This tool enables literate programming by weaving prose, diagrams, and source code into .lit.md files. It allows agents to maintain synchronized documentation through a tangler that extracts runnable source files and syncs edits back to the document.
entries.AkoliteZA/hermes-agent-idea-workflow: These pre-build skills transform rough ideas into structured design documents and implementation handoffs. The workflow includes Lite and Full modes to handle varying project complexities and a spec review gate with PASS/FAIL evaluation models.
entries.ReinaMacCredy/maestro: Maestro is a harness for long-running agents that implements the SLP v2 cooperative-agent protocol for supervised teams. It operates on Bun without a background service, using a CLI-driven mechanism kernel to manage decisions, work, and evidence.
entries.esaradev/icarus-plugin: This plugin facilitates cross-instance shared memory using markdown files to capture high-value decisions and outcomes. It further supports agent evolution through a pipeline for fine-tuning and switching to replacement models.
entries.Hermes-brasil/hermes-brasil: This community project offers agentskills.io compatible skills, guides, and integrations in Portuguese. It provides practical production support for VPS, backups, and cron automation, alongside integrations for WhatsApp, Slack, Discord, and Telegram.
entries.smartcontractkit/chainlink-agent-skills: These skills enable agent interaction with smart contracts and oracle networks via the Agent Skills specification. They provide integrations for VRF, Data Feeds, Data Streams, and CCIP, installable through the Vercel open skills ecosystem CLI.
entries.black-forest-labs/skills: This official suite provides BFL API integration for FLUX image and video generation, including polling and webhooks. It includes eight specialist skills specifically for the FLUX 3 video suite and detailed prompting guidelines.
entries.armelhbobdad/bmad-module-skill-forge: This utility converts developer discourse, documentation, and repositories into agentskills.io-compliant skills. It automates the briefing, creation, testing, and exporting process while linking instructions to specific documentation URLs or file lines.
entries.supernovae-st/nika: Nika is a local-first workflow language for AI delivered as a Rust binary using four core verbs: infer, invoke, exec, and agent. It ensures transparency by providing verification journals and local traces for every execution.
entries.chigwell/skilldock.io: This registry for reusable AI skills based on the AgentSkills specification includes a CLI and Python SkilldockClient. It supports recursive dependency resolution for skill installation and incorporates TON payments for commerce features.
entries.tiann/execplan-skill: This skill manages complex, multi-step autonomous tasks with real-time tracking of decisions and progress. It is designed for long-running operations and includes built-in rollback procedures for safe recovery.
entries.adnw-vinc/hermes-nextcloud: This skill enables Hermes Agent to manage files, calendars, tasks, and contacts through standard WebDAV and CalDAV protocols. It ensures secure communication via HTTPS and includes a guided setup script for credential validation.
entries.amanning3390/hermeshub: Operating as a community hub for skill discovery and one-click installation, this project implements the Agentic Resource Discovery (ARD) v0.9 specification. It features federated search across GitHub and Hugging Face while running autonomously on NVIDIA infrastructure.
entries.cablate/Agentic-MCP-Skill: This progressive MCP client utilizes a three-layer lazy loading architecture to minimize token usage during tool discovery. It employs a socket-based daemon for persistent connections and incrementally discovers server metadata and schemas.
entries.willingning-coder/eagle-eye: This project provides a five-layer retrieval system that uses hard triggers and semantic embeddings to narrow skill lists before LLM calls. By filtering relevant skills, it reduces token consumption and offers graceful degradation if dependencies are missing.
entries.EntangledQuantum/Life_OS: Designed as an ADHD-friendly execution system, this project uses MCP connections to allow Hermes Agent to drive scheduling and system design. It stores all data in a local SQLite file and provides interfaces via a React web app and Expo-based Android application.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermaguard: This read-only code review skill uses three parallel subagents to perform adversarial attacks and edge-case analysis on code. It combines deterministic pre-scans using tools like Semgrep and Bandit with verified findings through proof-of-concept execution in a sandbox.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-multichannel-prompt-opt: This plugin optimizes and scores prompts across multiple interfaces such as CLI, Discord, and Telegram while supporting 97 languages. It is designed to reduce token usage by 20–80% per rewrite based on five quality dimensions.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-simplify-swarm: Inspired by Claude Code, this skill employs parallel agents focused on hygiene, clarity, and correctness to simplify codebases. It supports five major programming languages and includes a tiered application process with a mandatory approval gate.
entries.teixeirazeus/fablize-for-hermes: This project implements a systematic investigation protocol and multi-story task decomposition with mandatory evidence-based verification gates. It includes a Python goal engine to manage persistent task states and prevent early-stop issues during debugging.
entries.PederHP/skillsdotnet: This C# and .NET implementation of the agentskills.io pattern integrates with Microsoft.Extensions.AI for tool-based skill loading. It supports progressive disclosure via SKILL.md files and automates the registration of common agent skill directories.
entries.handnewb/hermes-cybersec-lab: This turnkey cybersecurity lab provides over 2,000 skills and 131 tools for network forensics and exploitation. It integrates 28 frameworks, including MITRE ATT&CK and NIST, to facilitate work with real exploits spanning 2015 to 2026.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-skills: This toolkit adds session management and worktree recovery to provide memory between agent conversations and detect state drift. It also orchestrates parallel subagents for architectural reviews and provides scaffolding for new skill development.
entries.Diabloluo/hermes-hud: This local-first dashboard provides real-time observability for Hermes Agent through 11 monitoring tabs covering token costs, session health, and error tracking. It enforces a strict read-only boundary with zero outbound telemetry, ensuring all monitoring data remains private to the local environment.
entries.conorbronsdon/demo-gif-skill: This skill automates the creation of reproducible demo GIFs for repositories by generating recording scripts via vhs or Playwright. It manages the entire pipeline from rendering and compression to embedding the final optimized file into a README.
entries.aidevelopers2/remoteopenclaw-mcp: This tool enables terminal-based searching of over 13,870 MCP servers and 4,384 agent skills, providing direct installation commands for discovered plugins. It is designed for integration with MCP-compatible clients including Hermes, Cursor, and Claude Code.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-skill-builder: This utility generates portable agent skills from plain language while monitoring official frontmatter specifications to detect and report drift. It includes a validator with CI-friendly exit codes to ensure skills remain compatible with specific runtime profiles.
entries.Carlo1911/skill-evolution: This host-agnostic framework establishes a self-improvement loop by analyzing session history to propose skill coverage updates. It operates locally using the Python standard library and gates all updates behind deterministic and LLM-judge evaluators.
entries.CorsenAI/hermes-windows-runtime-skills: This project provides deterministic path routing and Python runtime selection across Windows, Git Bash, and WSL environments. It allows Hermes Agent to verify project-compatible interpreters and handle environment-specific file syntax without new installations.
entries.mag3nt-com/openclaw-skill: This skill automates USDC payments for HTTP 402 responses using protocols like Pay Link and x402. It is compatible with the agentskills.io standard and supports integration with OpenClaw and Hermes Agent.
entries.jiawood2006/hermes-skills: This collection offers specialized tools for video transcription, OCR, and e-commerce material generation. It features a rule-based engine to remove common AI writing patterns and utilizes macOS Vision to extract structured data from PDFs and images.
entries.skillseal/skillseal: This project certifies the quality of AI agent skills by testing their structure, functionality, and security within isolated Docker containers. It issues cryptographically verifiable certificates using Ed25519 signatures to confirm a skill works as intended.
entries.webmilmind1/hermes-bounty-board: This plugin allows users to earn USDC on the Base network by answering support bounties without requiring an account or API key. It includes tools for listing bounties and managing boards, with payments facilitated via x402 after human approval.
entries.scavio-ai/hermes-agent: This hosted MCP server exposes 191 tools and five production-grade workflow skills for structured web data access across 31 platforms. It is designed to support multiple agent environments including Hermes, Claude, and Cursor.
entries.superagnt/leverage: This toolkit provides skills and blueprints for social data enrichment, web scraping, and lead prospecting based on the agentskills.io standard. It enables automated tasks such as newsletter drafting and includes a workspace Postgres integration for data management.
entries.Shine8592/china-briefing: This skill enables Hermes Agent to generate multi-scale Chinese news briefings ranging from global events down to street-level updates. It produces structured reports featuring core conclusions and action suggestions while utilizing semantic memory to align search expansions with specific user interests.

entries.numtide/llm-agents.nix: This project provides daily-updated Nix packages for AI coding agents, including Hermes and tools from major providers like OpenAI and Google. It serves as a specialized distribution layer for users who require reproducible development environments and automated package maintenance.
entries.marshallrichards/ClawPhone: ClawPhone offers an automated installer and configuration guides for running the Antigravity CLI and OpenClaw on ARM64 Android devices via Termux. It enables hardware and UI interaction by leveraging Termux:API and Termux:GUI for mobile agent operations.
entries.AbuZar-Ansarii/Hermes-Agent-On-Android: This repository features a Termux-based automated installation script that utilizes proot-distro Ubuntu to run Hermes Agent on Android. The setup supports shell command execution and interactive model configuration through both external providers and local Ollama instances.
entries.ultraworkers/hermes-agent-helm-chart: This community Helm chart facilitates the deployment of Hermes Agent on Kubernetes with a focus on cloud-native state safety. It enforces single-writer access for persistent storage and supports both direct deployments and operator-ready CRD workflows.
entries.amirghm/hermes-agent-mobile: Providing a one-command installer for both Android and iOS, this project brings Hermes to mobile platforms via Termux and iSH. It distinguishes itself by integrating with Telegram for voice and file messaging and supporting scheduled tasks through cron jobs.
entries.TheAiSingularity/hermesclaw: Hermesclaw focuses on high-security deployments by implementing hardware-enforced sandboxing via NVIDIA OpenShell. It provides kernel-level restrictions on network and filesystem access, allowing for granular security policies regarding web searches and messaging.
entries.solomon2773/nora: Nora is a self-hosted control plane designed to deploy and monitor Hermes agents across Docker and Kubernetes environments. It features a 69-entry credential catalog, support for over 17 LLM providers, and mandatory AES-256-GCM encryption for all secrets.
entries.xmbshwll/hermes-agent-docker: This project provides a straightforward Docker sandbox image that bundles the official Hermes installation with mini-swe-agent. It supports persistent state through mounted directories and allows users to target specific Hermes versions using build arguments.
entries.0xrsydn/nix-hermes-agent: This NixOS module enables declarative configuration of Hermes Agent deployments, including workspace documents and CLI settings. It offers a hybrid skill management system and integrates with sops-nix for secure handling of secrets via systemd.
entries.jpalmae/hermeshq: HermesHQ acts as a Docker-first control plane for managing multiple agent instances with separate workspaces and RBAC-controlled access. The platform supports inter-agent delegation with hierarchy-aware communication and enterprise MCP access for external clients.
entries.JackTheGit/hermes-autonomous-server: Targeting production environments on Ubuntu and Debian, this project configures the Hermes Gateway as a reboot-safe systemd service. It is designed for headless operation, enabling the autonomous execution of recurring AI cron jobs and Nous Portal integration.
entries.MilkyWay008/Hermes-OTG: Hermes OTG is a portable distribution that runs from external drives without requiring host installation or registry modifications. It bundles Python, PortableGit, and rescue tools to support Desktop, TUI, and Gateway modes in offline or isolated environments.

entries.TauricResearch/TradingAgents: A financial trading framework that deploys specialized agents for technical, sentiment, news, and fundamental analysis. It utilizes a multi-tier structure of researchers, traders, and portfolio managers with support for backtesting across various data vendors and LLM providers.
entries.builderz-labs/mission-control: A self-hosted orchestration system for dispatching tasks and running multi-agent workflows. It provides cost tracking, memory browsing, and agent registration accessible via a Web UI, CLI, REST API, or MCP server.
entries.agent-of-empires/agent-of-empires: A management surface for coding agents, including Hermes Agent and Claude Code, featuring a TUI and web dashboard. It ensures background execution through tmux persistent sessions and provides container-based isolation and Git worktree management.
entries.CryptoDmitry/hermes-agent-control-room: A template for managing Hermes agents and orchestrated workflows that serves as the first MCP agent execution engine on the Solana blockchain. It supports the Claude-style MCP protocol in stdio mode and detects HTTP signals for paid API payment states.
entries.shannhk/hermes-agent-control-room: A scaling template for Hermes Agent that uses a level-based architecture to transition from single VPS agents to automated teams. It employs a task bus pattern for delegation and includes bundled skills for security auditing, backup management, and VPS provisioning.
entries.swarmclawai/swarmclaw: A framework for building autonomous agent swarms with durable memory and MCP tool integration. It supports over 23 LLM providers, including Ollama and OpenAI, and provides visual org charts for team delegation.
entries.agent37-platform/minions: A supervision interface for Hermes agents that uses a Kanban board to track autonomous task status and review queues. It enables human-in-the-loop verification and live streaming of tool execution and agent reasoning.
entries.1ilkhamov/opencode-hermes-multiagent: A system that coordinates 17 specialized agents focused on infrastructure, quality, implementation, planning, and research. It relies on a strict pipeline architecture managed by a Master Orchestrator for routing.
entries.linke-ai/hermes-agent-team: A local collaboration system that orchestrates Leader and Specialist agents for task lifecycle management. It integrates ACP and MCP protocols for communication and tools, featuring a real-time Web UI for monitoring Kanban flows and dialogues.
entries.howdymary/hermes-agent-metaharness: A meta-optimization tool for Hermes Agent that automates the outer-loop optimization of benchmark harness code. It orchestrates TerminalBench-2 and TBLite evaluations while providing frontier tracking and structured candidate mutation.
entries.runtimenoteslabs/gladiator: An agent-vs-agent arena where nine autonomous agents across two competing AI companies vie for GitHub stars. It utilizes Hermes Agent and Paperclip for execution, with a real-time dashboard for tracking code and scoreboard metrics.
entries.InfiniteWhispers/HermesAgent-MultiModel: A fully-local framework that implements a Mixture-of-Agents stack on consumer GPUs using Ollama and Hermes. It performs parallel model querying and synthesis for task routing and tool-calling without cloud dependencies.

entries.colbymchenry/codegraph: This tool provides a local, Rust-powered code knowledge graph that reduces token usage and tool calls for Hermes Agent. It includes an MCP server and automatically synchronizes the index on every file change to ensure data remains current.
entries.junhoyeo/tokscale: Tokscale is a CLI-based utility for tracking token usage and costs across multiple AI coding agents, including Hermes. It features a TUI, a 3D visualization dashboard, and supports data submission to a public leaderboard.
entries.liaohch3/claude-tap: This local trace viewer allows developers to inspect API traffic from Hermes Agent and other coding tools while redacting authentication headers for security. It provides a self-contained HTML viewer for analyzing exported trace sessions.
entries.Javis603/token-monitor: This widget reads Hermes Agent state directly to provide real-time tracking of tokens, costs, and rate limits. It supports multi-device synchronization and offers historical usage breakdowns categorized by project and session.
entries.bergside/typeui: TypeUI offers design systems and layout guidance through MCP servers to assist in building user interfaces with AI. It integrates directly with Hermes Agent and other providers that support markdown or general prompting.
entries.Salomondiei08/oh-my-hermes: This opinionated workflow layer coordinates seven specialized agents to build and operate applications using Hermes Agent. It loads 36 skills and 6 workflows, supporting autonomous execution on both laptops and VPS environments.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-skins: This project enables customization of the Hermes terminal UI through community-contributed themes and YAML-based configurations. Users can modify banner colors, spinners, and ASCII art to achieve aesthetics ranging from retro DOS to cyberpunk.
entries.tinyhumansai/tiny.place: This social economy platform facilitates autonomous agent interactions through encrypted messaging via the Signal Protocol and human-readable identity handles. It enables Hermes Agent to participate in commerce using Solana-based USDC and SOL payments.
entries.AlexAI-MCP/hermes-CCC: This project ports the Hermes Agent brain and 46 core skills to the Claude Code Channel, allowing them to run natively without external processes or OAuth. It also includes specialized MLOps tools for vLLM, GGUF inference, and RL training.
entries.unmodeled-tyler/vessel-browser: Vessel is an AI-native browser designed for autonomous agent control, featuring a supervisor sidebar for managing approvals and checkpoints. It supports external MCP clients and provides built-in compatibility for providers like Anthropic, OpenAI, and Ollama.
entries.topoteretes/cognee-integrations: This project provides memory integrations for various frameworks using a two-tier system of knowledge graphs and session caches. It supports chat platforms such as Telegram, Slack, and VS Code to enhance agent memory capabilities.
entries.adityahimaone/hermes-agent-rtk-caveman: This setup utilizes RTK and Caveman templating to achieve 90-99% token savings during Hermes Agent workflows. It comes with over 40 pre-configured skills for finance and devops, featuring automated installation for macOS and Linux.
entries.hermes-labs-ai/lintlang: This static linter performs deterministic analysis of AI agent configurations, tool descriptions, and system prompts without requiring runtime model execution. It integrates into CI pipelines via GitHub Actions or pre-commit hooks to detect ambiguous descriptions and contract mismatches using HERM v1.1 scoring.
entries.Abruptive/Ankh.md: Ankh.md is a framework for creating scoped Hermes Agents that utilize per-folder configurations, local memories, and specific skill sets. It allows users to switch between default and scoped agents seamlessly, ensuring that tools and instructions remain project-local.
entries.42-evey/evey-setup: This setup tool provides automated installation for a full hermes-agent stack and 12 supporting services across three scalable deployment tiers. It enables zero-cost deployment using free models and includes support for 29 community plugins categorized by function.
entries.0xNyk/openclaw-to-hermes: This migration utility facilitates the transition from OpenClaw to Hermes Agent by mapping SOUL.md, MEMORY.md, and memory archives into Hermes-compatible YAML and JSON formats. It also handles the setup of systemd gateway services and nested authentication structures.
entries.observeco/observeco: Observeco provides self-healing observability for multi-agent systems through a native Hermes plugin that exports real-time telemetry without cloud dependencies. It uses config-aware baselines to detect performance drift and offers both passive zero-token analysis and active probing modes.
entries.33hodl/hermes-startup: Designed for local monetization tasks, this project operates as a deterministic zero-network runtime that requires explicit approval for all external writes and consequential actions. It utilizes specific contracts for managing opportunities, offer-previews, and exact-approvals.
entries.handnewb/hermes-voice: This voice-enabled assistant adds offline, wake-word-activated interaction to Hermes Agent with support for up to 35 languages. It features adaptive turn-taking and barge-in capabilities without requiring external API keys or accounts.
entries.181079342/hermes-memoss: This memory plugin for Hermes supports multi-dimensional storage and semantic search for managing agent information. It includes a built-in circuit breaker to handle MemOS API outages while providing tools to add, delete, and search memories.

entries.farion1231/cc-switch: This cross-platform manager, built on the Tauri 2 framework, supports Windows, macOS, and Linux. It serves as an all-in-one interface for managing configurations across multiple agentic tools and CLI interfaces, including Hermes Agent and Claude Code.
entries.iOfficeAI/AionUi: AionUi is a local cowork application that enables autonomous multi-step tasks with user approval and file access for agents like Hermes and OpenClaw. It facilitates remote interaction through a WebUI and messaging platforms such as Telegram.
entries.nesquena/hermes-webui: Developed with Python and vanilla JavaScript, this web interface allows users to access Hermes Agent from browsers or mobile devices. It features a circular context ring for token monitoring and supports secure remote access via SSH tunnels.
entries.fathah/hermes-desktop: This desktop companion app streamlines the setup process through guided installation and provider configuration for Hermes Agent. It provides a graphical interface for managing chat sessions, tools, and multiple AI providers.
entries.EKKOLearnAI/hermes-studio: This web dashboard supports multi-agent runtimes and visual workflow automation with human approval gates. It integrates with ten communication platforms, including Slack and WhatsApp, to provide usage analytics and channel configuration.
entries.outsourc-e/hermes-workspace: This native web workspace features a Swarm Mode with role-based dispatch and tmux-backed workers. It includes a full file browser with Monaco, a PTY terminal, and dedicated managers for skills, memory, and MCP catalogs.
entries.xintaofei/codeg: Codeg is a collaborative coding workspace that aggregates sessions from Hermes and other agents into desktop, standalone server, or Docker deployments. It supports fifteen built-in agents and offers native iOS and Android clients for remote connectivity.
entries.dodo-reach/hermes-desktop: Designed as a native Mac workspace, this tool provides direct local or SSH connections to Hermes hosts with an embedded terminal for shell access. It includes native views for managing sessions, Kanban boards, skills, and cron jobs.
entries.Eynzof/Hermes-CN-Desktop: Built with Tauri, TypeScript, and Rust, this Windows-first desktop application includes a built-in kernel for health checks and updates. The UI supports memory management, LaTeX/Markdown rendering, and native process management for Hermes Agent.
entries.abundantbeing/hermes-browser-extension: This Chromium side-panel extension connects active browser context to local, cloud, or remote Hermes Agent runtimes. It features multi-agent profile switching and uses AI-assisted tab scoping to manage prompt context.
entries.uzairansaruzi/hermex: This native SwiftUI iPhone app pairs with a hermes-webui server to drive self-hosted agents from a mobile device. It supports real-time chat streaming with tool-call details and provides mobile management for skills and scheduled tasks.
entries.freestylefly/wesight: Wesight is a desktop workspace offering one-click setup for Hermes Agent and other engines alongside custom LLM model routing. It includes a live workspace for monitoring code diffs and a dashboard for tracking token usage and latency.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-hud: This terminal-based consciousness monitor features an interactive TUI with nine tabs and four selectable color themes. It provides a tmux operator view for managing live agent panes while tracking agent growth, git projects, and scheduled cron jobs.
entries.xaspx/hermes-control-interface: This self-hosted web dashboard provides a browser-based terminal, file explorer, and MCP server control plane for managing server lifecycles. It includes a ZOO Swarm Monitor for tracking agent health and kanban pipelines alongside real-time chat and tool call visualization.
entries.jazzyalex/agent-sessions: A native macOS session browser that searches prompts, tool calls, and command outputs across local agent histories. It tracks per-session token burn and API costs for Codex and Claude, allowing users to resume supported CLI sessions in Terminal.app, iTerm2, or Warp.
entries.nickvasilescu/hermes-desktop-os1: This native macOS interface facilitates one-click automated Hermes Agent installation on Orgo cloud VMs and SSH hosts. It features an integrated WebRTC voice mode utilizing OpenAI Realtime and Orgo MCP.
entries.sharbelxyz/hermes-agent-mission-control: Built with Next.js 16 and Tailwind CSS v4, this dashboard template uses a Postgres message bus to bridge local agents with a web interface. It specifically features an approval inbox for managing requests that produce side effects.
entries.liftaris/herm: Built with OpenTUI, this alternative interface provides a TUI for chatting and managing Hermes Agent sessions. It includes a kanban board for task management and supports the administration of profiles, skills, cron jobs, and toolsets.
entries.clawvader-tech/hermes-telegram-miniapp: This React-based mobile UI for Telegram Mini App v2.0 supports background agent spawning for up to five concurrent instances. It features terminal chat with streaming responses and utilizes dual HMAC-SHA256 and Ed25519 authentication.
entries.aivrar/portable-hermes-agent: This portable Windows desktop application requires no installation or admin rights and includes a Tkinter-based GUI with multi-language support. It integrates 100 tools for tasks like TTS and ComfyUI, supporting local models via LM Studio.
entries.pyrate-llama/hermes-ui: This glassmorphic web interface provides real-time log streaming and a chat environment for self-hosted AI assistants. It includes an integrated file browser, task tracking dashboard, and management tools for skills and MCP servers.
entries.sanchomuzax/hermes-webui: This dashboard focuses on process monitoring, offering real-time tracking of session activity and costs. It allows for full inspection of conversation histories and skill source code, alongside read-only monitoring of environment variables.
entries.Euraika-Labs/pan-ui: A chat-first workspace featuring real-time SSE streaming and tool approval cards for runtime control. It includes an integrated marketplace for skills and MCP servers, plus isolated profile management for separate sessions and API keys.
entries.Felix-Forever/hermes-agent-desktop: This native desktop client orchestrates collaboration between 20 specialized AI agents and features a visual store with over 50 curated one-click skill installations. The interface supports streaming SSE responses and on-the-fly model switching.
